exercises.zh: 人們在暖天季節會購買更多凍飲。
exercises.upgrade: People buy more cold drinks during the warm-weather season.

options.explanation: Warm season — means the warmer part of the year and may not exactly match calendar summer. This is climate-based and may not map exactly onto summer. The decisive clue is that consumer behaviour is linked to warm weather.

Summertime — means the period of summer, especially as a general time of year. This is natural for general seasonal timing, but it is less suitable for formal climate, administrative or month-based contexts. The decisive clue is that consumer behaviour is linked to warm weather.

Summer months — means the months generally associated with summer. This narrows the meaning to a span of months and is less suitable when the context treats summer as a climate or seasonal category. The decisive clue is that consumer behaviour is linked to warm weather.

Holiday season — means a holiday or peak travel period and is context-dependent. This describes a holiday/travel period and does not necessarily equal summer. The decisive clue is that consumer behaviour is linked to warm weather.

Warm-weather season ✓ — means the part of the year characterised by warm weather. Here, consumer behaviour is linked to warm weather. That makes Warm-weather season the most precise replacement for this particular sense of summer.
Winter — means the cold season and is the opposite seasonal concept. This is the opposite seasonal concept. The decisive clue is that consumer behaviour is linked to warm weather.

exercises.zh: 城市大部分戶外節慶都在暖和天氣時節舉行。

falseSynonyms.zh: 盛夏 ≠ whole summer midsummer 指夏季中段或最盛夏時期，不是整個 summer。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Midsummer is only the middle/height of summer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 暑假 ≠ summer summer break 是假期，只是夏季中的一段時間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Summer break is a holiday period.

falseSynonyms.zh: 假日季 ≠ summer holiday season 依地區可指不同節慶／旅遊旺季，不等於夏季本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Holiday season is context-dependent.

falseSynonyms.zh: 旱季 ≠ summer dry season 是降雨型氣候季節，可能與 summer 重疊，也可能不重疊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Dry season is rainfall-based.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在氣候型熱季接近 hot season 可能與 calendar summer 不完全一致。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Hot season is climate-based.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在氣候型暖季接近 warm season 可能跨越或不完全等於 calendar summer。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Warm season is temperature-based.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在月份時間段 sense 接近 summer months 強調月份期間，不是所有 summer 用法都可換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Summer months is period-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞形陷阱 summer 是名詞／可作定語；summery 是形容詞，表示有夏日感的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Check word class and meaning.
